name: cadenza
description: CADENZA — collaborative music streaming platform (MERN + TypeScript + Clerk + Socket.IO)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace server" "npm run dev --workspace client"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace server && npm run build --workspace client
scripts.preview: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run start --workspace server" "npm run preview --workspace client"
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace server && npm run lint --workspace client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace server && npm run typecheck --workspace client
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace server && npm run test --workspace client
